name: plain table
sql: SELECT id FROM analytics.public.orders

name: quoted names keep their case
sql: SELECT 1 FROM "Analytics".public."orders"

name: postgres folds to lower
sql: SELECT 1 FROM Sales.Orders

name: joins
sql: SELECT o.id, c.name FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN sales.regions r ON r.id = c.region_id

name: duplicates reported once
sql: SELECT * FROM sales.orders a JOIN sales.orders b ON a.id = b.parent_id

name: casts
sql: SELECT created_at::date AS day, amount::number(10,2) FROM sales.orders

name: json path access
sql: SELECT payload:customer.id::string AS customer_id, payload:items[0]:sku FROM raw.events

name: qualify
sql: SELECT * FROM sales.orders QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY created_at DESC) = 1

name: ilike
sql: SELECT * FROM sales.customers WHERE email ILIKE '%@example.com'

name: lateral flatten
sql: SELECT e.id, f.value:sku::string FROM raw.events e, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => e.payload:items) f

name: table flatten
sql: SELECT f.value FROM raw.events e, TABLE(FLATTEN(e.payload:items)) f

name: generator reads nothing
sql: SELECT SEQ4() AS n FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(ROWCOUNT => 10))

name: select star exclude
sql: SELECT * EXCLUDE (ssn) FROM hr.employees

name: information schema
sql: SELECT table_name FROM analytics.information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'PUBLIC'

name: semantic view checked by name
sql: SELECT * FROM SEMANTIC_VIEW(analytics.models.revenue DIMENSIONS customer.region METRICS orders.total)

name: pivot
sql: SELECT * FROM sales.monthly PIVOT (SUM(amount) FOR month IN ('JAN', 'FEB'))

name: cte name is not a table
sql: WITH recent AS (SELECT * FROM sales.orders WHERE created_at > '2026-01-01') SELECT * FROM recent

name: cte shadowing a real table reads the real one
sql: WITH orders AS (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE amount > 0) SELECT * FROM orders

name: later cte can use an earlier one
sql: WITH a AS (SELECT * FROM sales.orders), b AS (SELECT * FROM a) SELECT * FROM b

name: earlier cte cannot see a later one
sql: WITH a AS (SELECT * FROM b), b AS (SELECT 1 AS x) SELECT * FROM a

name: recursive cte sees itself
sql: WITH RECURSIVE tree AS (SELECT id, parent_id FROM org.units WHERE parent_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT u.id, u.parent_id FROM org.units u JOIN tree t ON u.parent_id = t.id) SELECT * FROM tree

name: cte is out of scope outside its query
sql: SELECT * FROM (WITH x AS (SELECT 1 AS a) SELECT * FROM x) s JOIN x ON TRUE

name: qualified name never matches a cte
sql: WITH orders AS (SELECT 1 AS id) SELECT * FROM orders JOIN sales.orders s ON TRUE

name: subquery in from
sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM sales.orders GROUP BY 1) t

name: subquery in where
sql: SELECT * FROM sales.customers WHERE id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM sales.orders)

name: exists
sql: SELECT * FROM sales.customers c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales.refunds r WHERE r.customer_id = c.id)

name: scalar subquery in select
sql: SELECT id, (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM sales.orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id) AS biggest FROM sales.customers c

name: union
sql: SELECT id FROM sales.orders UNION ALL SELECT id FROM archive.orders

name: no table
sql: SELECT CURRENT_DATE()

name: defaults qualify short names
sql: SELECT * FROM orders JOIN staging.events ON TRUE JOIN other_db.x.y ON TRUE

name: extra allowed table function
sql: SELECT * FROM TABLE(parse_rows('a,b'))

name: qualified function names are never allowlisted
sql: SELECT * FROM TABLE(my_db.public.parse_rows('a,b'))

name: history table function is rejected
sql: SELECT * FROM TABLE(INFORMATION_SCHEMA.QUERY_HISTORY_BY_USER(USER_NAME => 'someone'))

name: unknown table function is rejected
sql: SELECT * FROM TABLE(my_udtf(1))

name: dynamic table name is rejected
sql: SELECT * FROM IDENTIFIER('sales.orders')

name: explain is rejected
sql: EXPLAIN SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales.orders

name: show is rejected
sql: SHOW TABLES

name: describe is rejected
sql: DESCRIBE TABLE sales.orders

name: writes are rejected
sql: DELETE FROM sales.orders

name: two statements are rejected
sql: SELECT 1; SELECT * FROM sales.orders

name: garbage is rejected
sql: SELEC * FRM orders

name: unknown dialect is rejected
sql: SELECT 1
